name: crons
title: Crons
description: Code-first cron starter for Cirrus — a cirrus/crons.ts that declares recurring jobs with cronJobs() (interval / daily / weekly / monthly / raw cron) plus an illustrative internal function they fire, discovered by codegen and synced into wrangler.jsonc.
docs: Edit cirrus/crons.ts to register your jobs against internal.* function refs, then run `cirrus codegen` — codegen lifts the schedules into wrangler's triggers.crons and a dispatcher map the Worker's scheduled() handler consumes. The shipped cirrus/crons/jobs.ts is an example internal mutation; point the sample job at your own internal function and delete it.
